blocks.text: Continuous spectrum bremsstrahlung, yani braking radiation (brake lagne, yani achanak rukne se nikalne wali radiation), ki wajah se hai. Tez electrons target se takra kar achanak slow (dheeme) ho jate hain. Hum jante hain ke accelerate hota hua charge (jis ki velocity badal rahi ho) electromagnetic radiation chhorta hai. Is liye target mein tezi se decelerate (dheema) hote electrons radiation chhorte hain. Deceleration itna zyada hai ke radiation ki wavelength chhoti hoti hai, aur bremsstrahlung X-ray region mein hoti hai. Agar koi electron pehli hi collision mein apni saari kinetic energy kho de to woh saari energy ek X-ray photon ban jati hai jis ki energy hfₘₐₓ hai:

Fig. 20.6 ki sab se chhoti wavelength λₘᵢₙ isi frequency fₘₐₓ ke mutabiq hai (Ve = hfₘₐₓ = hc/λₘᵢₙ). Baqi electrons pehli collision mein saari energy nahi khote; rukne se pehle kai collisions karte hain. Is se kam energy, yani lambi wavelength, ke X-ray photons bante hain. Yun electrons ke decelerate hone se continuous spectrum banta hai.

blocks.prompt: 50 kV par chalne wali X-ray tube se nikalne wali X-rays ki sab se chhoti wavelength λₘᵢₙ nikalein.
